title: Understanding The Principle of Construction and Development
paragraphs: I now have appointments to speak with more than 17 Fortune 500 companies and 12 other companies that deal with management, development and training. They all request training from a biblical perspective, which is very interesting. Why? Because the world system is no longer effective. This is why this issue is of great importance, as we will be discussing this vital topic of "construction," and I wanted to present this image because it is a symbol of the pillars that support everything. We will focus on leadership.

Built to last. When you are hit by storms, pressures, and all those hardships, do you still stand firm? I don't think we've seen a more tragic fall of leadership than we have in the past two decades. We saw Martha Stewart walking around with a leg brace. After her release from prison. One of the world's most successful businesswomen went to prison for compromising her principles. And of course, we have seen major companies like Enron where their executives were imprisoned for stealing money.

They were already millionaires. Why do they steal money? Well, corruption in the mind breeds corruption in actions. These are the people who lead us economically. Then, of course, we had Catholic priests who were convicted of abusing children, both boys and girls. These are the people who are supposed to protect the children. But our leaders have fallen. Now Catholic priests are being prosecuted, some have been imprisoned, some are on trial, and they are forced to pay fines in the millions.

What kind of leaders do we follow? Then we have government leaders being prosecuted for their political disasters. Some of them are being prosecuted because they stole from their country's treasury. Others are being tried for abusing the very people they were supposed to protect, by killing people. I mean, what kind of world are we looking at? Therefore, in all areas – economic, religious, and political – our leaders have let us down.

In fact, many churches in this same city suffer from leaders guilty of compromising principles, dishonesty, and corruption, not only financially but also morally. In fact, you know some of them. What a tragedy. Who will be held accountable when all this is over? When people are under too much pressure, they simply collapse under its weight. We need leaders who are steadfast. This is why this topic is extremely important. I have been doing what I am doing now for 32 years.

I started helping by training and teaching people when I was fifteen years old. I started very young. In fact, by the time I turned seventeen in my country, my name was on everyone's lips. Our organization started then, when I was seventeen. We have become known throughout the country. In fact, my prime minister invited me to meet him when I was eighteen years old because he felt nervous.

He felt nervous because, you know, in those political environments, anyone who can mobilize more than a thousand people becomes the focus of politicians' attention. And so I gathered five thousand teenagers when I was seventeen years old, and I taught them the principles that I had learned and that had helped me from the Bible. The Prime Minister wanted to meet me and we had a conversation.

We became close friends after that, and at one of our meetings two weeks later, he surrendered his life to Jesus at a meeting for teenagers. So you never know how God might use you. I have been doing that ever since, and I still do it now. I have been married to one woman for 26 years. She was the first woman in my life. I am a loyal man. I tell you this because you see many leaders appearing as fleeting stars. You know, a passing star is a star that shines brightly and then dies. Some people are like this.

They appear suddenly. They do a great job and then they fall. We need consistent and reliable people. They can weather the storm and emerge stronger. They go through tragedy and emerge from it stronger as well. People abandon them, yet they continue to work on their own. Look, we need leadership built to last. Now, what I want to focus on is how to develop a strong and stable leadership? This is an important question. Actually, here's what I want to eat tonight.

I want to address the understanding of the principle of construction and development. We are talking about building people, building your leadership personality. We will focus on building on solid foundations, because beautiful buildings do not derive their safety from their beauty. Rather, it derives its security from its foundations. The most important part of any building is the foundation. That's why the foundation is always laid first. More money is invested in the basics than in the entire building.

In fact, if you study the value of this building, you will discover that they put more resources and money into building the foundation than they put into these walls and this roof. Because the foundation is the key to any building. Did you know that if you threw a stone and broke the windows of this building, the government would not condemn the building? If you brought in a bulldozer and demolished these walls, the government would not condemn this building. They will keep saying it's a good building.

If you remove this roof and destroy it, the government will not condemn this building. In fact, the Ministry of Works will keep the permit for this building valid, because whatever you do to it, it remains valid. They will not condemn him. However, if the government discovers a crack in the foundation anywhere, the Minister of Works will revoke the permit for that building and condemn it. Isn't this amazing?

You see the chandeliers, the tables, the walls, the paint, the gold door handles, and the silver utensils, but none of this impresses the government at all. What fascinates them is: Is the foundation still solid? Because the value of any building lies in its foundation. Write this down. The key to success in any building is the foundation. Most of us pursue beauty, but you should pursue stability, not beauty. Condemnation comes when the foundation of the structure is destroyed.

Therefore, do not be impressed by people who have luxurious chandeliers in their lives, a beautiful exterior, flashy styles, or attractive personalities. Don't trust those things. Do you want to know what they were built on? Where did they come from? What is the structure of their foundation? Actually, let me put it this way. This is very important. We can handle this within two days. Did you know that when God created the human race, the human race was a construct? God created the human race. It's a building.

God laid the foundation for that human race. What was that basis? He was a male. The first human being created by God was a male. The male was placed at the base of the entire human structure, thus forever establishing that the male in society is the foundation of the entire human society. Male, not female. God did not just place the remembrance of God first, but He also gave the remembrance of God all the instructions first. In fact, God never spoke to Eve directly.

If you read your Bible carefully, you will find that all instructions, whether about the tree, the commandment, naming animals, etc. , have been given to the male only. All of that was given to the male. The man was the one who received all the information first. Then, when that was over, God said it was not good for this man to be alone. The woman did not come from dust. Rather, it came out of the man. Therefore, it came out of the man's own being. In reality, woman is built upon man.

Therefore, the concept you have learned that behind every great man is a woman is not biblical. The truth is that behind every great man there is a great woman, and here silence reigns. That is the biblical structure. Look, we keep reversing the structure, let me explain it this way. If the woman is behind you, when life attacks you and pushes you down, you will fall on top of the woman. And that's exactly what's happening. The opposite is supposed to happen.

When life attacks a woman and pushes her, she falls on solid ground. This is why single mothers are suffering now, because there is no basis for enduring the pressures. We will discuss this topic in two days. Good? We will talk about family structure because that is important. If you study Satan and his strategy of destruction, you will find that he was not interested in Eve. That was not his intention. His attention was focused on the man, but he could not reach him.

So, he got to influence the man, and he hasn't changed his tactics since because they work for him. Every great man who has fallen in history, there was a woman behind his fall. All of them. We can start with Adam. Then we move on to Abraham. Abraham made concessions because of a woman. She made him sleep with her maid. I mean after God spoke to him. A woman made him sleep with her. A woman made him listen to her instead of listening to God. Women have a strong influence. Elijah.

Elijah was a man who called for fire from heaven and burned 800 prophets. But one woman made him run away and hide in a cave. A woman with a strong influence. David. Saul killed his thousands. David killed tens of thousands. But one woman brought him down. Should I continue? Jimmy Swaggart. The man of God who won thousands for Christ. One woman brought him down. Jim Baker, founder of Christian television. One woman brought him down. President Clinton. One woman brought him down.

When the foundation is destroyed, the whole house collapses. The Bible never says that sin entered through one woman. When Eve saw the tree, nothing happened. When I picked the fruit, nothing happened. When I ate from the fruit, nothing happened. When I chewed it, nothing happened. When I swallowed it, nothing happened. Why? Those were the windows and doors. But when she took it to her husband, the foundation, the strong foundation, the book says: “When she took it, she ate.” The next word is: " immediately".

Therefore, when we talk about leadership, we must focus on understanding the value and importance of the foundation. I have a small idea here that I want you to write down in your notes: building or rebuilding, because when you talk about building you have to be careful because building means something new. I didn't come here to talk about new buildings. When you talk about building strong leadership, I didn't come here to give you new building materials.

This is important because I am not in the construction field. I work in the field of reconstruction. To build means to use new materials. God is not interested in building. It focuses on reconstruction. He works in the field of restoration. He is at the service of reconciliation. It is in the service of recovery. Revival, not just life. Redemption, not just appreciation. A reward, not just compensation. It's about refreshing your mind. Not giving you a new mind. Are you still with me?

It is not about abandoning us, but about reclaiming us. He wants us to repent. We don't just regret it. Then he wants us to take things back. It's not just about covering up anything, but about restoring what we have lost. So we are in the business of reconstruction. When I stand before these government leaders and teach them the principles and commandments that I share with them, they always think that I am smart. In fact, they are fans. They become very surprised.

They say, "Oh, where did you get this wisdom from?" And I say to them: "Ancient wisdom. It is older than man. It came from the source." You see, what makes us lose the effectiveness of leadership is that we keep adopting new systems and principles that have not been proven correct, and they bring destruction. Therefore, we are in the field of not building, but rebuilding. Genesis Chapter 6 Verse 13. God said to Noah, “This is how you must build it.” God did not just tell Noah to go and build a ship.

He even gave him specific instructions on how to do it. God doesn't just want you to go and build. Here is another phrase that I found interesting. In the Book of Psalms, Psalm 127:1, it says: “Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. ” Unless the Lord watches over the city, the watchmen stand guard in vain. The city will never be safe.

That is why there are crimes every night, and destruction somewhere in this city, because they are trying to build it based on their philosophies and principles, and it is not working. Because God has His own way of building. God is working in the field of leadership to restore everything. Let everyone say: Restore. restoration. Let's talk about recovery quickly. I will give you a list to write down. These are the things you need to restore anything.

God works in the field of restoring humanity, restoring the principles of leadership, leadership styles, and leadership philosophies. It works to restore everything that was lost due to the fall. Therefore, God is in the realm of restoration. How do you get something back? Well, first and foremost, in order to restore or rebuild anything, you need to get the original blueprint. This is very important. In other words, you cannot find a new architectural plan to restore something. There are old buildings.

You know, this picture I put here is of an old church in this city. It's a cathedral here in England. This is an old building. They say it's over 90 years old. A very old building. And now, the plans for that building exist somewhere. When the building begins to deteriorate, and its parts begin to collapse, they have to go back and return to the original plan. They simply cannot design a new plan. If you are going to restore or rebuild something, you must first obtain the original blueprint.

If you use anything else, this is not a restoration. I destroyed the building. Secondly, in order to restore or rebuild something, you need the original material. This is extremely important. If you are going to restore an old house, an old car, an old boat, or something else, you should use the original material. Now, if there is an old house in your city and the government wants to restore it for future generations, if they use modern materials for that restoration, then that is no longer a restoration.

They literally have to go back and find the original material used, because the original material is the only thing that preserves the quality and value of the building. So if the building requires stone and you decide to put up plastic because plastic is more weather-resistant, then you have not restored the building. I literally destroyed the building. Can my voice reach you? Good. We are talking about leadership building. We are talking about original leadership. We cannot use modern materials.

Have you ever heard of a strong necktie? What is a strong necktie? Look, you're wearing one of them. This is a modern term. Your driving style is influenced by the type of tie you wear or the type of suit a woman wears. They have all these specific colors. They discovered all of that scientifically. What they forget is that whoever wears it has no personality. do you understand? They completely missed the point. You cannot improve the original material. The original material is the character first, then the tie.

You can go to school and learn ways to influence or manipulate people, such as how to win friends, without having any personality. So, when the pressure intensifies, it collapses. Original material is required if you are going to rebuild something. And the third, write this down. Restoration means the original process. In other words, those of you who come from Africa or the Caribbean, there are things you grew up eating that had a special way of being processed. Welcome.

Now, you go to the store and find modern versions in boxes. Is anyone talking to me? You know it's not the real thing, right? They say, "No, no." I understand. Because although the product was available, it did not go through the correct process. There are many leaders like that. They look appropriate, they have the right titles, clothes, terminology and slogans, but they haven't gone through the process. We put them in charge of the children's church. We put them in charge of specific departments.

We give them a title or make them deacons, and they have not gone through the process. If you want to restore, you must also follow the process. How did they make this wooden roof a thousand years ago? Well, they cut wood from a certain forest. They dipped it in a certain type of oil. They left it soaking for five months, then carved it and fixed it. You must do this if you are going to renovate the building. You have to take the same wood from the same forest, put it in the same oil, and wait for 5 months.

You have to trim it and then install it. Now you have a restored building. If you use modern wood without soaking it in the same process they used, the building will no longer be original. That's why God, you know, couldn't solve our problems by snapping his fingers. There had to be a process. If you are going to become the person you were born to be, whether you are a woman or a man, or a great leader, then you must learn the processes that God put in the original blueprint for making a leader.

Let me give you an example. This is very deep. This is a profound matter. do you understand? Listen to this. This is profound. Deep, at least for me. Good? Did you know that there were two Adams? Am I right? There is the first Adam, and there is the last Adam. Okay, the last Adam. Both humans. Now, the first Adam failed. Am I right? Adam II succeeded. It took me a long time to figure out why the first one failed. Here's an example. The first one failed because, firstly, he had no parents.

Secondly, he had no history. Third, he did not receive an education. Fourth, he had no previous experience. Fifth, he did not undergo any kind of tests. Sixth, he had no reference. Seventh, he did not have a library. Eighth, he had no source from which to learn. Adam II, let's talk about him for a minute. Firstly, he had two parents. Secondly, he had a history. It started as a baby. As for the first Adam, he appeared suddenly. Boom. An adult. Adam the First, and Adam the Second.

Look, I believe that God— please forgive my strange words—I believe that God said, " This will never happen again." I will never make an instant adult again. I understand that. Why? There is no process. Do you know what the Bible says about Jesus as a successful leader? He says he learned obedience. Learn, learn what? Learn obedience. how? Through the things he suffered. Which means he was allowed to pass through it. How wonderful. That's why it didn't fail. He had two parents to train, raise, and correct him.

He had a history. Never trust anyone except through their history. Do n't let anyone's PhD influence you. You should know their history. Because if they don't have a history, when the storms come, they will collapse. That's why you're going through some tough times right now. Because this is part of the process. If you don't get through the difficult times you're going through now, how will you cope with the heavier times that await you at the level you're supposed to be living at?

Because the higher you climb, the greater the challenges. By the way, God always elevates you by making you face giants. God will bring you, or allow you to go through, a challenge as big as the promotion he is taking you to. The third operation. If you want to restore something to its original state, you must follow the original systems that were used in it. Number four, five, you must remember that restoration preserves the value of the object.

You know, I was in Colorado visiting a friend after a conference and I went to his house, and in his garage there were two cars, and outside the garage there was a new car. There were old cars in the garage. I mean, you're talking about the 1930s. One of the cars dates back to 1925. These are cars like the "T Ford", old cars, you know. Outside there was a BMW and behind it another Mercedes. I said to him, "Why do you put those in the garage, protected, and not these?" He said, " Those are new cars."

He said: "Because the cars in the garage are more valuable." I said to him, " Why?" He said, "It has been restored." He said: "The Mercedes cost $80,000, but the Ford T-Class cost $280,000." "And I'm not driving it." Is anyone following me? Write this down. Everything that is restored is more valuable than what was just created. That is why you are more valuable to God as a redeemed creature than if God had started over and made new humans. That's why we need people like you who deserve to be leaders.

You must go through the original materials, the original process, and the original system in order for your value to be greater than flashy, sudden success stories that fade under pressure. I don't want to see another leader printing his own cards, distributing his own pamphlets, calling himself something. It doesn't work that way. The process. How many people in leadership, even in a religious context, have never gone through a process? They confuse talent with personality.

As soon as they show a little talent, they head straight to the printing press. They print an identification card. You will find written on it: a messenger, a prophet, or something similar. I sit there wondering, " What do you mean by prophet? You haven't even had a spiritual father yet. You haven't been trained in a church. Who is your spiritual father? Has he ever corrected you, disciplined you, rebuked you, or guided you? How much time have you spent under his supervision?

Look, we have these people who haven't gone through the right process. That's why they're not valuable. My teacher, Ole Roberts, sat me down one day and said, ' Grow where you were planted.' This was repeated by my friend Corrie Ten-Bum, who passed away. She's the woman about whom the film ' The Hideout' was made. She sat me down for lunch one day. She was about 82 years old and said, ' My son, grow where you were planted.'" Don't move. He went through the process. Your value is determined through this process.

Do not trust leaders who appear suddenly. Because leadership is not a set of methods and techniques that you learn in classrooms. I will show you in a little while where leadership comes from. Sixth point, restoration makes the product more valuable than modern models. Do you know that that $280,000 car is worth more than a 2005 Mercedes because the car has a history? It has been restored. The steel in that car is genuine steel. As for the steel in Mercedes, it is mixed with all kinds of materials.

I want you to go outside and tap on the fender of your car, then find an old car and tap on it. You will hear two different voices. It is more valuable. God is not interested in creating new people. God wants to rebuild people. What a lovely statement. He wants to rebuild you. God wants to restore to you the original things you have lost, such as the Holy Spirit, such as wisdom from above, not from your schoolbooks, such as discernment. Things you can't get anywhere else except from the factory. This is leadership.

Let's talk about the power of principles and precepts because they are the source of original materials. Now, this might be a bit heavy for you. So, listen carefully, we have an additional 15 minutes. So, I will stop at exactly nine o'clock. So, I need to move quickly and I want you to ask me questions afterward. Good? Is this acceptable? Yes. They exchanged a few questions for a few minutes. Good. Now, I have talked about the original materials. I want you to think about these two words: precepts and concepts.

Because, above all, the principle is the key to the original material. The word " precept" actually means the original idea. The word " sett" means idea. The word "Pre" means before. Therefore, "precept" means the previous idea. So, a precept is the original idea underlying the idea you have. There's an idea behind that. That is called a precept. That is the original. It's the most original idea. It is called a precept. Let everyone say: precept. Precept. The principle, then, is original information.

Now, the word concept (concept), you see the word "cept" in it again. What does the word "cept" mean? an idea. The word " Con" means together. Therefore, the concept means an idea that has been deduced or completed. In other words, the precept precedes the concept. The concept is a product of the principle. The principle is the original idea. The concept is that idea after it has been deduced. Therefore, the concept is a picture of an idea that you can see because it is a complete conclusion. It's understandable.

But there is one word I want you to remember. Principle. A principle is the original law produced by a precept. It is the fundamental law or essential rule produced by the precept. When we talk about building leaders who can withstand pressure and difficult times, you should go back to the original material. That's why older cars are stronger. That is why the old buildings in this city last longer than your modern homes, because they dealt with original material. The essence was original.

Ah, the bumper on the front of your car. Is this what you call it? buffer. It looks like steel, doesn't it? Try hitting him. It is fiberglass. Now go and find an old car and hit the same thing. It is solid steel. That's the original idea. Look, what they did was copy the idea, but not the material. There are many leaders like this. They are acting like Fred Price. They walk back and forth like, you know, Joyce Myers. They, you know, preach like Kenneth Copeland.

They want the service to be like J, and they all have the same movements. They wear neckties. They wear suits. It's plastic. Let me tell you something about plastic. If you put heat next to plastic, that's why I never feel impressed or threatened by the competition. Sometimes you feel like, God, you know, this neighboring church is growing and they're doing this, just listen, study the leader and you'll know what's going to happen. It has to come from somewhere. Where did you come from? What is your history?

What was your original idea? A very important concept. principle. What is the principle? Loudly. The principle is an original law resulting from a will. Now, what is the will? An original idea. I want you to be very smart when you leave at night. Therefore, a will is the most important thing in life, a will because a will is the truth. What is the truth? Original information. That's the truth. Therefore, everything else is false. If it is not the original idea, then it is false.

It sounds good, it sounds audible, it sounds pretty, but it's not good. So these philosophies that we continue to receive in college, you know, when I went to university, I enrolled in some of them and I was studying management, business and leadership. The first things they made me read were Plato, Aristotle, and Socrates. Now, none of these are in the Bible. They told me that these men's ideas were the best ideas for our societies today.

Therefore, the philosophy of our social structure today is based on these Greek philosophers and their ideas. I always tell people that the world is run by dead people. Absolute truth. Because we live by their ideas, and you went to university and they made you study these men as a basic requirement. Why? They are trying to get their ideas into your head because our social society is built on the ideas of those Greek philosophers. Therefore, we are not based on biblical philosophy.

We are based on Greek philosophy, which was adopted by the Romans. Keep in mind that Great Britain is a product of Rome. This is why our philosophy and social systems are built on these flawed philosophies. But there is an idea that predates Plato. There should have been an "Amen" here. In any case, there are ideas older than Aristotle. She predates Socrates. You should look for older ideas. I remember when they asked Jesus a question, they tried to trick him.

They asked, "Should a man divorce his wife for any reason and every reason?" This is in Matthew 19. Jesus said, "He knew what they were looking for, didn't he?" He asked, "Who wrote the divorce certificate?" The question was posed to them in response. In other words, where did this idea come from? Because it certainly did not come from me, and I am God. In other words, divorce is not an original idea. Marriage is the same. They said to him, "O Moses," and he said, "You are right."

He said, " Because in the beginning it was not like that." Look, he's back to basic principle. This is true leadership. True leadership always comes back to the basic principle. That's why they keep inviting me. As you can see, when I talk to them, I talk about principles. You cannot argue about a principle because it is the original truth. People can argue about your opinion. This is why arguments occur, but they cannot argue about a fact, because the fact is reasonable, logical, and rational.

Here is a saying of Christ. We often misunderstand this saying, I think, because it is not practical unless we understand it in the right way. He says, "I am the way, the truth, and the life." Let me quote it the way it might be said today. I am the path to truth that gives you life. Why? I am the manufacturer. If you want to know the original idea, you have to come through me. If I give it to you, you will finally know what real life is.

Because no one knows the original idea better than the person who came up with it. Isn't that true? Yes. So, we are talking about rebuilding and restoring leadership that lasts. We need to go back to the original information about driving. Everything else is, uh, flawed. Defective. Good. Principles. Yes. The power of principles. Here's why David was such a successful man in the eyes of God. There are only three people whom God described as his friends in the Bible. Or at least he referred to them as friends.

Only three. Ah, one of them is Moses, another is Abraham, and the third is David. But there is only one person about whom God said this. This is a man according to my heart. God did not say that about anyone else. Now, I will show you why, and this can be said about you too if you learn it today. David knew that the secret to success was not learning God's concepts, but rather that the secret to life was learning God's principles. I read this from the Bible.

There are dozens of verses in the Bible, especially in the Book of Psalms, that you have never noticed, where David kept asking not for concepts from God, but for principles. Read aloud together. Come on, David is speaking in Psalm 119:4, read it. You gave your instructions to be diligently kept. If only my paths were straight. In other words, if I hold fast to your commandments, I will be as firm as a rock. Notice now, he says: You made the commandments. from?

God originally laid down the original ideas for everything. The cat, the dog, the bananas, the trees, the seeds, the animals, the sun, the moon. God established all the original laws that must be followed. Therefore, if you learn it, you will live and be steadfast. My friends, the secret to my success is not in acquiring information. Let me tell you something, my friend. Listen to me carefully. Knowledge is not power because you may be well trained to make mistakes.

The Bible never says that knowledge will make you free. I have three university degrees. three. Most of what I learned is not true. Therefore, I do not rely on those certificates. I obtained it when they were studying communism. I studied communism and many other things, and all of that is now gone. My certificate is useless. The only thing that will give you success is a will. What is a will? Let's go. The original idea. You want to return to what is in God's mind, not what is in his hands.

Look, religious people love God's hands. Bless me. Give it to me. Give it to me. Bless me. God said, “ Look, that is why the Israelites do not know me. They love my hand, but David wanted my mind. Moses wanted my mind.” What is on your mind, God? I want to know what your thoughts are, not what your actions are. I want the original material. Oh, hallelujah. I have set commandments that must be obeyed, and I want to obey them in order to be steadfast. What about this? Psalm 119:45. Read. Let's go. I will walk in it.

Let's go. I will walk in peace. Why? Because I asked for your commandments. And I will speak of your testimonies before kings. Look, I told you I would do that. I do that. I have been invited to speak to prime ministers, presidents, and governments at training opportunities around the world. They think I'm smart. No, I only learned the life commandments that exist in the mind of the life maker. And when I present it to them, they say, "Wow, where did you learn this wisdom?" Simply put, go back to the original idea.

For example, male is an original idea, and female is an original idea. Now, any mixing of these two is not an original idea. Look, people come up with these ideas, and what do they say? They usually say things like, "But you see, these are new times, a new day, modern times, and we need to update," and they have this notion that reality changes. You know, the seed is a principle. The seed and the plant are a principle. No matter how long you live, the seed will always produce trees.

No matter how modern you are, the seed will only produce a tree. And so is life. I have never seen a fish decide and say, "I have been swimming for the last ten thousand years." "I'm going to go ahead and fly now." "No. Swimming is a principle for the fish. Look at the first verse again. Principles are made to be obeyed. If the fish stays in the water, it lives. Obedience. If it leaves the water, it dies. Disobedience. See, the principle doesn't change. You can change, but the principle doesn't.

And you can never violate a principle. You can only violate yourself. This is very important. Look at that last phrase. I want you to remember that if you are going to be great as a leader— and listen, my friends, I wish I could beg you to believe this—there is no one in this room, listen carefully, no one in this room who has any obstacle preventing them from being great. This is the secret. If you learn the principles, they will seek you out. Theology doesn't elevate you in life. It's the principles.

What is a principle? The original. See, if you study them and you're doing well, man, don't stop. See, thirst for them, find them. See, that's what I found. I found them.
